page.layout: One column of names, each year printed at the left margin beside its entry; marginal notes in a column at the right. Each entry is one line of the list, grouped by year and separated by rules. Printed page number at the top.

page.notes: Year numbers 1464–1470 stand in the left margin, each beside its entry; placed beside the entry nearest to them. Right-margin notes are assigned to the nearest entry by position. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "adiuvantib. a graritis", "popolscit". Possible printing errors left as printed: "Gron.", "Collumanis", "Dammonenses". Rules between groups are not transcribed.
